mentions.name: Orbi
mentions.description: Open-source (AGPL-3.0) AI agent that takes a request all the way to a release: you describe what you want in a sentence, an AI agent writes the code and opens a PR, a separate review session checks it against the acceptance criteria, and Orbi merges and tags a release. It also handles ops issues like deploys and debugging; in October 190 of 197 PRs merged into its own repo were opened by Orbi.
